Why do Stars and Toman prices differ?
Stars are Telegram's currency for digital goods and are priced separately. Both give exactly the same access.
What about prompts I bought individually?
They stay in your library forever, even without a plan.

faq.title: Before you buy
items: Every version runs on its target models with three real inputs, and an automated judge grades it on a fixed rubric (relevance, completeness, format, language quality, safety). Below 80 it doesn't ship.
What happens when a new model ships?
The update agent re-tests every prompt in that model family. If the score drops, a new version is written, free for past buyers.
Telegram Stars in Telegram, the Bale wallet in Bale, and soon by card on the website. 7-day money-back guarantee.
Can I use prompts for my clients?
Yes, commercial use is allowed. Only reselling the prompt itself is not.
Yes. Agents collect trend signals only and write the text from scratch; every prompt passes an originality check before it ships.

about: Most prompts you find online were never tested on a real model, and machine-translating them into Persian or Arabic ruins the result. We built Rasa Prompt so every prompt is run, scored and localized before it is sold.

A team of ten specialist agents finds trends in public sources, writes original prompts, tests them on target models and localizes them into three languages. A human editor reviews everything before it ships.
Transparent quality scores and test dates, respect for other authors' rights, minimal user data, and a 7-day money-back guarantee.
terms: By using the Rasa Prompt website or bots you accept these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the services.

A purchase or plan gives you a perpetual, non-exclusive license to use the prompts for personal and commercial work, including client work. Reselling, publicly publishing or repackaging the prompt text is prohibited.
Ownership of outputs you create with AI models is governed by that provider's terms. We don't guarantee a specific result; the quality score reflects our testing, not a promise.
Monthly run credits are non-transferable, have no cash value and expire at the end of the period.
Using prompts for illegal content, deception, harassment or infringing others' rights is prohibited and may lead to account suspension.
These terms may be updated; we announce material changes inside the bot.
privacy: In the bots: your messenger numeric ID, display name, language and purchase history. On the website: anonymous technical logs only, and your language and theme preference stored in your own browser.
To deliver purchases, provide support, prevent abuse and improve search (zero-result searches are analyzed without personal identifiers).
Your phone number, card details or contacts. Payments happen directly in Telegram or Bale.
We keep data only as long as needed. To delete your account entirely, tap Support in the bot.
We never sell your data. When you run a prompt, your input is sent to the model provider only and never shared with advertisers.
refund: Within 7 days of any purchase (single prompt or plan), if you're not satisfied, we refund the full amount.
Tap "🆘 Support" in the Telegram or Bale bot and send your order number. We usually reply within 24 hours.
Telegram Stars go straight back to your Telegram account. Bale wallet payments are returned to the same wallet.
Access to the related prompt or plan is revoked. Repeated abuse of the guarantee may lead to account limits.
